name: CN-NEWS-Microphone
logline_subject_info: The professional microphone used by the reporter, branded with the 'CN NEWS' logo.
visual_desc: A close-up shot of a professional broadcast microphone. It is a sleek, black handheld 'stick' microphone. Fitted over the metallic grille at the top is a square foam windscreen, also known as a mic flag. The flag is a deep blue color, and on its front-facing side, the logo 'CN NEWS' is printed in bold, white, sans-serif lettering. The object is displayed against a blank, solid deep-charcoal background with soft studio lighting. The foam windscreen (mic flag) has the 'CN NEWS' logo on it.
video_visual_desc: A black broadcast microphone with a square, blue foam windscreen featuring the white 'CN NEWS' logo.
